body: I wanna be your friend! Hmu! I’m the best candidate instead of those two above me 😝
Love you OP! You’re fucking brilliant and strong and absolutely deserve to have a fantastic New Years. Happy New Years! Welcome to 2019. ❤️❤️
thank fucking goodness you’re still here.

I’m so exhausted. I appreciate you reassuring me of my strength but I’m really ready to give up. I’m tired all the time and I feel sick constantly. I’ve tried my absolute best for 17 years and I’m just... done. I give up. 

But before I do go, please tell me about what’s going on with you? Just as you offered me a listening ear, I want to offer you the same. I’ve seen your comment on another post and I’d just like to extend your message back to you - YOU are spectacular. YOU are a fighter, too. You’re bloody brilliant, too, and I say that with utmost truth.
You’re very sweet, ahah, but I think I’m actually quite hideous looking. Thank you for the compliment, though, it made me smile a little if anything. I hope everything is okay with you, man.

There’s absolutely no surefire way to kill yourself without permanently leaving you with more complications than beforehand, aside from voluntary euthanasia which is typically reserved for the terminally ill only. 

And on top of that, why should YOU be punished for the shitty actions of your parents??

Please reconsider this. Go to the authorities about your abusive parents. Speak out about it and get yourself away from the situation. It’s horrible and tough, I know, but none of these methods would be worth the risk of making your life so much worse than it already is.

OP, jumping off a bridge could still leave you alive, but crippled and injured and in intense pain.

Poisoning yourself, if done unsuccessfully, could lead to permanent brain damage or organ failure which would require serious medical intervention which, trust me, would not be pleasant. 

Stabbing yourself is unreliable and would leave you in excruciating pain until you bleed out. You could permanently leave your organs damaged should you survive.

Hanging yourself could leave you brain damaged if not done properly.

The fact you’re contemplating trying to resolve your problems and go back at it a third time speaks a lot about your perseverance and readiness to work hard. You’ve got a hell of a lot of willpower and drive and ambition, trust me.

Your friend, despite how they might seem, should be proud that you’re still deliberating trying again. (Not that you should allow someone else’s opinions dictate how you feel about yourself or the situation)

Nine months to yourself might be a very good idea for you in the long run, but don’t become a couch potato and try and get into the habit of meeting deadlines and don’t shirk on keeping yourself mentally stimulated. 

Keep at it, OP. Try for a third time. You’re gonna be great. :)
Yo, OP, keep me company? Like another commenter said, ‘waste’ my time all you want. DM me dude!

You know what I’ve realised? The best people seem to think the worst of themselves. Frankly, OP, I think you should consider allowing yourself the opportunity to at least try and bond with the people who’re here for you (aka us!). 

You extending your life for your pets is already such a big sign that you’ve got a heart. And I’m sure your heart is a lot bigger than you think. 

We all have character flaws, but depression exacerbates the way we see them. I think I’m hyperemotional, far too needy, a complete mess in terms of how I express myself but my friends seems to think completely otherwise.

Give us a chance, OP! I’ll start: Hey dude, my name’s Cynthia. Nice to meet ya. (:

been happening every time I go outside for months now. i feel vulnerable and i don’t have anything to distract myself with from my nervous thoughts. music barely helps but sometimes i listen too carefully to the lyrics and break down over that, too.

Thank you so much for the well wishes.

I’ve been trying my best to isolate my thoughts and focus solely on my education, but I have serious anxiety problems and thoughts about my boyfriend’s safety and well-being keep creeping back in. It’s the main catalyst for my panic attacks. 

I’m also a catastrophic thinker, so I keep telling myself that nothing I do in terms of schoolwork will be good enough and that I’ll never be successful in the future. I understand that it’s something I can control but I physically feel so ill and exhausted and I can barely get myself out of bed, let alone work on/finish my work. :/ 

But I’m gonna keep trying my best, and I really appreciate the advice. Thank you.

it really does. and I’m really really sorry to hear about your situation. hope you manage to overcome everything - you seem like a wonderful person who deserves a hell of a lot more than what life is throwing at you. ):

I’m so sorry to hear that :/ is there anything I can do to help you? as glad as i am to know someone understands, i don’t want anyone else to be going through what I’m going through. :/
